effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Entertainment] trait card and 1 [Awakening], [Tool] or [Navi] trait card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon get linked to a [Entertainment], [Tool] or [Navi] trait card, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
